name: Rotten Leather Cap

name: Manticore Leather Cap

name: Wyvern Leather Cap

description: It is a radiant cap of fiery phoenix leather, edged with copper flames, shimmering bronze feathers, or glossy iron plumes, or enchanted with trailing silver fire, brilliant gold veining, or vibrant star metal plumage sparking with magical embers.

name: Primitive Leather Jerkin
description: It is a rough, sleeveless jerkin of patched rawhide, reinforced with crude copper discs, thick bronze links, or dull metal plates, or decorated with primitive silver stamping, chunky gold knots, or ancestor-marked panels of mystical star metal.

name: Goat Leather Jerkin
description: It is a fitted, supple goat leather jerkin with copper buttons, bronze buckles, or chain-stitched steel trim, or adorned with silver scrollwork, gold-inlaid seams, or ethereal star metal studs at the shoulders.

name: Elk Leather Jerkin
description: It is a robust jerkin of heavy elk leather, decorated with copper-accented lacing, hammered bronze fasteners, or steel-linked panels, or elevated with intricate silver beading, golden embroidery, or star metal filigree down the chest.

name: Manticore Leather Jerkin
description: It is a menacing black jerkin made of spiny manticore hide, with copper spine reinforcement, bronze talon clasps, or menacing steel trim, or as a rare treasure detailed with gleaming silver runes, golden monster motifs, or spectral star metal studs.

name: Wyvern Leather Jerkin
description: It is a sinuous, dragon-scale jerkin crafted from lustrous wyvern leather, trimmed with copper scales, bronze shoulder guards, or articulated metal rings, or enchanted with silver dragon runes, gold-plated scale overlays, or brilliant star metal accents.

name: Phoenix Leather Jerkin
description: It is a vibrant jerkin of brilliant phoenix hide sewn with copper feathers, bright bronze lining, or flexible steel vents, or as a piece of high magic with swirling silver fire, gold-thread flames, or iridescent star metal filaments.

name: Long Leather Leggings
description: It is a protective, high-waisted leather leggings reinforced with copper patches, crested with bronze bands, or armored with iron plates, or bearing magical motifs in silver, radiant gold inlays, or streams of woven star metal through the seams.

name: Goat Leather Leggings
description: It is a tough, fitted goat leather leggings with small copper rivets, bronze buckles, or steel-kneed guards, or delicately adorned with silver edgework, gold tracery up the sides, or elegant star metal flecks that shimmer with every step.

name: Elk Leather Leggings
description: It is a broad, thick elk leather leggings fastened with copper hooks, bronze-looped straps, or rugged steel bands, or gracefully decorated with silver-leafed symbols, golden embroidery, or patterns of shimmering star metal.

name: Manticore Leather Leggings
description: It is a wild, coarse leggings of thick manticore hide with copper claw guards, bronze spike studs, or interlocked steel rings, or enchanted with glowing silver runes, golden monster-hide motifs, or celestial star metal lines along each limb.

name: Wyvern Leather Leggings
description: It is a scaled leggings crafted from resilient wyvern leather, overlain with copper studs, bronze knee-caps, or black metal bands, or wreathed in enchanted silver filigree, gold patterns, or luminous star metal veinwork reminiscent of a dragon's form.

name: Phoenix Leather Leggings
description: It is a magnificent, flame-hued leggings of phoenix hide, tipped with copper talon-guards, edged with bronze checks, or laced with iron, or set aglow with silver fire threads, arcs of molten gold, or flickering star metal that radiate magical warmth.

name: Ripped Chainmail Coif
description: It is a battered, torn hood of interlocking copper links, faded bronze rings, or rusted iron loops, frayed and missing sections, later enchantable as tarnished silver, dented gold, or dull, cracked star metal with haunting remnants of lost magic.

name: Bronze Chainmail Coif
description: It is a protective coif of tightly-woven, gleaming bronze rings, with a subtle reddish sheen, accented by strong copper trim, or upgrades in mystical silver brilliance, embossed gold border, or shimmering star metal highlights.

name: Iron Chainmail Coif
description: It is a rugged hood crafted of overlapping iron links, weathered and gray, showing marks of hard battles, or magically transformed with shimmering silver rings, rich gold-weave, or deep blue star metal emitting faint celestial light.

name: Silver Chainmail Coif
description: It is a radiant coif of pure, polished silver mail, each ring etched with tiny runes, glowing faintly, with a silken inner lining and sparkling under any light, exuding an aura of protective enchantment.

name: Gold Chainmail Coif
description: It is a luxurious coif crafted from shining golden links, ornate and masterfully joined, every ring reflecting warm light with intricate decorative trim and a regal, enchanted aura of nobility.

name: Star Metal Chainmail Coif
description: It is an awe-inspiring coif of gleaming, deep indigo star metal whose rings shimmer with embedded stardust, each link seemingly pulsing with cosmic power and mystical energy.

name: Ripped Chainmail Hauberk
description: It is a battle-damaged long shirt of torn, dented copper mail, scorched bronze bands, or corroded iron loops, missing patches and frayed hems, or enchanted with faded silver, cracked gold, or star metal that glows mournfully with ancient runes.

name: Bronze Chainmail Hauberk
description: It is a sturdy, knee-length hauberk of bright, intricately linked bronze rings, reinforced with copper-banded edges, with enchanted forms glowing silver, gilded with swirling gold, or traced with constellation-like star metal veins.

name: Iron Chainmail Hauberk

name: Silver Chainmail Hauberk

name: Gold Chainmail Hauberk
description: It is a magnificent hauberk of solid gold links, ornate and polished to a mirror finish, laded with lavish filigree, exuding an enchanting, regal presence.

name: Star Metal Chainmail Hauberk
description: It is a legendary hauberk of otherworldly star metal rings, deep blue with starspark inlays, softly glowing and shrouded in an aura of stardust, a relic of celestial power.

name: Ripped Chainmail Chausses
description: It is a tattered leggings of copper, bronze, or iron rings—frayed, broken, and incomplete, or as magical relics with tarnished silver, battered gold, or faintly glowing star metal intricately shattered and repaired by forgotten enchantments.

name: Bronze Chainmail Chausses
description: It is a leggings formed from tight, flexible bronze links, burnished with copper patches, their magical brethren enchanted in brilliant silver, opulent gold, or ethereal star metal swirling with night energy.

name: Iron Chainmail Chausses
description: It is a sturdy iron chain leggings, matte and utilitarian, links darkened from use, while enchanted versions shimmer with protective silver, gleam with ornate gold, or radiate the mystical energy of woven star metal.

name: Silver Chainmail Chausses
description: It is an artisan-forged chausses of gleaming silver links, etched with tiny runes, soft yet incredibly strong, glowing under moonlight or magical influence.

name: Gold Chainmail Chausses
description: It is an opulent chausses fashioned from interwoven gold links, radiant with rich embellishments and glowing subtly with a powerful magical enchantment.

name: Star Metal Chainmail Chausses
description: It is a celestial leggings of star metal chain, each link radiant blue or silver, shimmering like a constellation, and exuding an aura of mystery and cosmic shielding.

name: Ironheart Greaves
description: It is a sculpted greaves with a raised heart design, made in copper, rich bronze, or black iron, or magic-forged with silver, inscribed gold, or gleaming star metal.

name: Ironbound Greaves

name: Deathless Iron Greaves

description: It is a smooth, low helm fashioned from black spider chitin and webbed with copper wire, bronze filigree, or shadowed steel, or mesmerizingly enchanted inlaid with silver web motifs, gold fangs, or luminous star metal spinnerets.

description: It is an alien, jagged helm of voidling chitin with eerie copper whorls, deepset bronze, or matte black metal tips, or unsettling enhancements in swirling silver, eerie gold, or star metal glowing with otherworldly light.

name: Mantis Chitin Carapace Greaves

name: Gold Meteoric Helmet

name: Star Metal Meteoric Helmet
